hypotheses.rationale: The expressions share an affine structure in one parameter: G0002 is the constant derivative of F(t), while G0003 is exactly F(sig2). G0001 is algebraically the same specialization F(sig2) after expanding the numerator. G0004 is the difference of these two equal specializations.
